name: Expanding Search
description: Search icon that springs open into a full field and collapses when empty and blurred; '/' focuses it from anywhere.
a11y: role=search form; labelled input and buttons; Esc clears and collapses.
prompt: Create an expanding search: a pill form whose width springs 44↔300px; the icon button opens it (or '/' globally), input autofocuses, a clear button appears with text, blur on empty collapses, Esc clears and closes.

name: File Dropzone
description: Drop zone that lifts and glows on drag-over; dropped files fly into a list with per-file animated upload progress.
a11y: Zone is a button that opens the file picker; hidden input is labelled; list is aria-live.
perf: Per-file intervals; layout animations on the list.
prompt: Build a file dropzone: dashed card that scales 1.02 and tints on dragover (icon bobs), opens the picker on click; dropped/selected files prepend to a list (layout springs) each with an extension badge and an animated progress bar that turns green at 100%; remove buttons slide items out.

name: Elastic Slider
description: Range slider that stretches like rubber when dragged past its ends and springs back on release.
a11y: Thumb is role=slider with arrow/Shift/Home/End keys and aria values.
perf: scaleX on the track driven by a motion value.
prompt: Create an elastic slider: pointer capture on the track sets the value; overshoot beyond either end (clamped 60px) becomes `overflow` which scales the track X by 1 + |o|/400 from the opposite origin; on release spring overflow back to 0 (500/18).

name: Animated Select
description: Custom listbox select: the menu unfolds from the trigger, options stagger in and a highlight follows the active option.
a11y: Button + listbox with aria-activedescendant; ↑/↓/Enter/Esc; click outside closes.
prompt: Build an animated select: trigger shows the value with a chevron that flips; the listbox scales Y from .85 (origin top) with a snappy spring, options stagger 25ms, a layoutId highlight follows hover/arrow keys, and the selected option shows a check.

name: Tag Input
description: Chip input: Enter or comma pops a tag in, Backspace arms then removes the last tag, duplicates wiggle instead of adding.
a11y: Native input with label; each chip has a labelled remove button; two-step Backspace avoids accidental deletion.
prompt: Create a tag input: chips pop in with a bouncy spring (layout), Enter/comma adds, duplicates trigger an x wiggle, the first Backspace on empty input tints the last chip red and the second removes it.

name: Donut Chart
description: Donut chart whose segments sweep in sequence on view; hovering a segment or legend item thickens it and updates the center.
a11y: role=img with a text summary of all segments; legend mirrors the data as text.
prompt: Build a donut: one SVG circle per segment with pathLength 1, strokeDasharray `frac−gap 1` and strokeDashoffset animating to −cumulativeStart (staggered 120ms) on view; hover thickens the stroke and dims others, and the center shows the hovered percentage.

name: Activity Rings
description: Apple-Watch-style concentric rings that sweep to their goals on view, with an overlapping second lap past 100%.
a11y: role=img summarizing each ring's percentage; values also listed as text.
prompt: Create activity rings: concentric circles (stroke 14, 3px gaps) with an 18%-opacity track and a progress arc (pathLength 0→min(1, value/goal), staggered 180ms, 1.4s expo-out); if over 100%, draw a second shadowed arc for the overflow after the first completes.

name: Orbiting Integrations
description: Integration icons circle a center logo on concentric dashed orbits at different speeds, staying upright as they travel.
a11y: Decorative motion; list your integrations in text too. Static under reduced motion.
perf: Each ring is one rotating element; icons counter-rotate.
prompt: Build orbiting icons: each orbit is a dashed circle rotating 360° linearly (optionally reversed); icons are placed around its circumference by angle and counter-rotate at the same speed so they stay upright; a solid logo tile in the middle.

name: Contribution Heatmap
description: GitHub-style contribution grid whose cells fill in a diagonal wave on view, with a hover readout.
a11y: role=img with a total summary; the readout text updates on hover.
perf: Spring per cell on first view only (≈200 cells).
prompt: Create a contribution heatmap: a 7-row column-flow grid of 12px cells with 0–4 intensity levels (color alpha), scaling in from 0 with delay (week + day) × 15ms when in view; hover shows the value in a caption.

name: Pinned Scroll Story
description: Apple/Stripe-style story: text steps scroll by on the left while the sticky visual on the right swaps for the active step.
a11y: All steps' text is in the DOM in order; visuals are supplementary.
perf: Native sticky; one scroll observer computes the active index.
prompt: Build a pinned story: two columns; left has one 70vh-tall block per step (inactive steps dim to 25%); right column has a sticky 70vh visual that swaps (scale/blur crossfade, popLayout) to the step chosen by floor(scrollProgress × steps) with offsets ['start center','end center']; progress pips on the side.

name: Zoom Through Text
description: Scrolling zooms through a giant word until its letterform fills the screen, revealing the image behind it.
a11y: The word is real text; reduced motion shows the image without the zoom.
perf: Single scale transform on a blended layer.
prompt: Create a zoom-through: 260vh section with a sticky 100vh stage; a full-cover background-colored layer with a giant word uses mix-blend screen (light) / multiply (dark) so the letters become windows onto the image; scroll scales the layer 1→40 from the word's counter and fades it at the end while the image scales 1.4→1.

name: Counter Preloader
description: Brand intro: a huge counter races to 100 on an ease-out curve, then the panel wipes up to reveal the page. Skippable.
a11y: role=status with the percentage; Skip button; never shown under reduced motion.
prompt: Build a counter preloader overlay: dark panel with brand + Skip, a giant number counting 0→100 with a cubic ease-out over `duration` (rAF) and a progress hairline; at 100 exit with clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) (0.9s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.18,1)).

name: Morphing Shape Loader
description: A single shape that morphs circle → rounded square → blob while rotating — a loader with character.
a11y: role=status with label; reduced motion pulses opacity instead.
perf: border-radius + transform keyframes on one element.
prompt: Create a morph loader: one square span whose border-radius animates 50% → 22% → '50% 50% 12% 50%' → 50% while rotating 0→360° and pulsing scale, 2.4s ease-in-out infinite.

name: CSS Motion Path
description: Objects travel along an SVG path using CSS offset-path, auto-rotating to the curve — zero JavaScript.
a11y: Decorative; travellers sit at the midpoint under reduced motion.
props: SVG path data (viewBox units = px of the container).
prompt: Make CSS motion-path travellers: draw the path as a dashed SVG; each item has `offset-path: path("…")`, `offset-rotate: auto` and animates offset-distance 0→100% with negative delays to space them evenly. Container size should match the viewBox.

name: Shape Morph
description: Gradient shape that springs between blob, star, heart and square — paths share 8 cubic segments so they interpolate cleanly.
a11y: role=img with the current shape named; instant under reduced motion.
prompt: Create a shape morph: author each shape as the same command structure (M + 8 C segments + Z) so Motion can tween `d` point-by-point with a soft spring (90/14); cycle through the sequence on an interval; gradient fill.

name: Curtain Page Transition
description: Layered colored panels sweep up to cover the screen, the route swaps underneath with its title shown, then they sweep away.
a11y: Navigation is real buttons with aria-current; reduced motion swaps instantly.
perf: Three transformed panels during the transition only.
prompt: Build a curtain transition: on navigate, three full-size colored panels slide in from y 100% (staggered 80ms, cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1)), the top one shows the destination title; swap the page at ~650ms, then panels exit to y −100% in reverse order.
